welcomeMessage.title: DIFFERENT ROOTS • SAME DREAMS
welcomeMessage.subtitle: Two Beautiful Cultures, One Sacred Union
welcomeMessage.text:
The Meeting
Like a warm Kerala sunset and Assamese breeze our paths crossed and our life became more colourful.

The Journey
What started as friendship grew into love filled with laughter, long conversations, shared dreams and two beautiful cultures came together.

The Forever
Today, as WE begin our next chapter, We invite you to be part of love, laughter and memories that will make our story forever even more special.

dressCode.themeSubtitle: Traditional Splendor with Royal Gold & Pastel Tones
dressCode.description: We warmly invite you to celebrate our union by donning Indian ethnic attire celebrating the cultural splendor of Kerala and Assam.
dressCode.attireMen: Traditional Kerala Mundu with Gold Zari / Kurta Pajama / Bandhgala / Nehru Jacket in pastel or ivory shades.
dressCode.attireWomen: Traditional Kasavu Saree / Assamese Mekhela Chador / Silk Saree / Lehenga in royal gold, rose, or pastel hues.
dressCode.note: Comfortable footwear is recommended for the mountain resort lawns and garden pavilions.
